english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an advantage, including one side of “pros and cons.”
This is the all-purpose choice for a benefit or positive consequence, especially when asking what benefit something gives.
This is the all-purpose noun for an advantage or positive effect.
Use this for a concrete advantage or benefit that someone receives.
Use 好處 when the sake involved is a concrete benefit someone receives rather than personal consideration.
Use this when the good means a benefit or advantage that promotes welfare or success.

examples.english: The pro of this plan is that it saves money.
examples.traditional: 呢個方案嘅好處係慳錢。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 fong1 on3 ge3 hou2 cyu3 hai6 haan1 cin2

examples.english: What is the advantage of doing this?

examples.english: The benefit of this plan is that it saves time.
examples.traditional: 呢個計劃嘅好處，就係慳時間。

examples.english: The biggest benefit of the company buying medical insurance on our behalf is that we don’t have to pay for doctor visits.
examples.traditional: 公司幫我哋買醫療保險，最大嘅好處係睇醫生唔使自己畀錢。
